name: Rai
source:
A skilled bounty hunter who wields two swords and a sharp tongue. His 'catchphrase' is "baka neko" (stupid cat), which he uses liberally on everyone, but especially Konoe. Despite his cold and arrogant attitude, he can be surprisingly caring.

[Edited from [url=http://lamento.wikia.com/wiki/Rai]Lamento Wiki[/url]]
